name: HirePulse Company Intent Radar (Clay HTTP Action)
description: One call to hirepulse/company-intent-radar per company domain: open jobs, Google ads running now, organic traffic and SEO trend, email provider, a 0-100 intent score and a one-line summary.
pricing_note: $0.03 per company report, charged only when the full report was produced. The free Apify plan returns hiring and email signals for up to 5 companies per run; Google ads and SEO traffic need a paid Apify plan.
